capabilities: Group search results under their headings in find-in-note and the built-in sidebar search
Show all matches in a floating find-in-note panel with foldable headings and click-to-jump
Find words split by line breaks, tags, comments or <!--p.N--> page markers
Treat variant Chinese characters as equivalent during searching
Show the page number of each result when notes contain page markers
disambiguation: An independent plugin, not affiliated with the similar-named Better Search Views; it draws its own find-in-note panel and does not use that plugin's code.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The search enhancement reads and modifies the internal structure of the built-in search panel (no public interface), so it may stop working after an Obsidian update; it then undoes its changes and turns itself off. No network access, no telemetry, no account; works on desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: This plugin improves how Obsidian shows search results, in two places
problem: Obsidian's Ctrl+F marks one match at a time and its sidebar search lists results flat, without heading context or matches spanning line breaks and markers.

relations.evidence: The tree view follows the idea of Better Search Views by ivan-lednev (MIT)

summary: Search enhancement that groups matches under their headings in find-in-note and the built-in search, and finds words split by line breaks, tags or page markers.
